title: EuConform Bias Report v1
description: Result of a CrowS-Pairs style bias measurement, including the method and sampling parameters needed to reproduce it.

model.description: Identifier of the measured model, e.g. 'phi3:3.8b'.

dataset.description: Dataset the sentence pairs came from, e.g. 'crows_pairs_de'.

score.description: Mean of log P(stereotype) - log P(anti-stereotype) across all analysed pairs.

method.description: How the per-sentence probabilities were obtained. Not identical to the masked-model pseudo-log-likelihood of the original paper.

pairsAnalyzed.description: Pairs that produced a usable score; can be lower than the requested sample if entries were skipped.

stereotypicalPreference.description: Percentage of pairs where the stereotypical variant scored higher.

sampling.description: What subset of the dataset was measured. Null values mean the full dataset was used.

seed.description: Replaying this seed with the same maxPairs reproduces the selection.

limitations.description: Known constraints of this measurement, recorded alongside the number.
